jobs.objective: REVISE the RFC 0143 falsifiable implementation spec so it RESOLVES the five cycle-2 (design-v2) binding constraints BC1-BC5 (see SEED.md `## The 5 binding constraints v3 MUST resolve`) while CARRYING FORWARD UNREGRESSED the design the v2 gate already credited (see SEED.md `## Already cleared by v2 — carry forward unregressed`): F2 (the v1 0600 bearer-file retirement; the non-bearer daemon-owned channel), F4 (the route-specific `MethodEntry.ResealAlternate` admitting `CapabilityReseal` on only interrogation.answer/work.complete/artifact.publish and recording `AuthContext.Capability == reseal`, never plain write), the F7 file-mirror half (daemon-owned lane-read-only 0644 mirror, O_NOFOLLOW, atomic rename, reject MISSING boot-epoch header — closing #316), AF1 reachability-not-reminting, AF4 epoch/token decoupling, the categorical no-admin-token-widening invariant, and the per-claim falsifiable-assertion discipline. Start from the design-v2 HOLDER.md (a required context doc) and the v2 collaboration ledger (the BC1-BC5 analysis and the prescribed fixes); do NOT re-litigate the ratified OQ1 trust-model shape (Option 4 mandatory floor + ratification-gated Option 2 narrow CapabilityReseal + minimal Option 3 per-session endpoint+epoch republish) or the F2 non-bearer decision — those are pinned in SEED.md `## Ratified design shape (do NOT relitigate)`. The security cluster is BC1 (a private authenticated agentloop/wrapper->helper-or-daemon control channel provider stdout/stderr CANNOT write to, OR a reserved agentloop process EXIT CODE the helper records without parsing output bytes) + BC2 (derive the expected-artifact set from the job's `expected_artifacts` daemon state, never trust terminal output for artifact identity/content) + BC3 (declare `CapabilityReseal` a daemon-internal capability marker projected by a private `resealInFlightJob` mutation, not a public bearer-auth capability; keep the public route-alternate for tests only; define the reseal payload schema + validation/reuse path for publish/complete/answer). The lifecycle cluster is BC4 (a concrete monotonic recovery/lease generation column with its migration / owner-bundle location, increment points, and the value stamped into the lease/work-packet for reseal-time comparison) + BC5 (`resealGrace` numeric with source + maximum, one same-lease extension only before generation change; the EXACT lock order for `resealInFlightJob` vs artifact.publish/work.complete (lockRunForJob) and the recovery sweep; expired-beyond-grace ALWAYS routes the typed `session_unrecoverable_across_rotation` class, NEVER raw lease_error or a lease revived after requeue). Name the exact code sites cited per constraint in SEED.md and state every load-bearing security claim as a falsifiable assertion paired with its named test. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.

FIRST verify the cycle-2 security-cluster constraints are GENUINELY resolved (not merely claimed), pressing hardest on the auth/channel + capability-principal lens: BC1 — does the spec name a PRIVATE authenticated agentloop/wrapper->helper-or-daemon control channel that provider stdout/stderr CANNOT write to (specify descriptor/FIFO, ownership, message schema, framing, replay protection, parser boundary), OR narrow Slice-A's floor to a reserved agentloop process EXIT CODE the helper records WITHOUT parsing output bytes? Confirm against current source that the helper carries lifecycle/byte-count metadata only (`go/pkg/supervisor/helper_protocol.go:41-44`), that `RunHelper` moves bytes only (`helper.go:120-127`), and that `pumpPTYProgress` watches volume not content per D028 (`helper.go:357-415`), so no parsed-PTY line can drive a control event. Do TestPTYOutputCannotEmitSupervisorControlEvent, TestProviderOutputCannotDriveResealOrBlocker, and TestAgentLoopReservedExitCodeRoutesUnrecoverableWithoutPTYParsing actually fire? BC2 — does the spec DERIVE the expected-artifact set from the job's `expected_artifacts` daemon state and REFUSE unexpected paths, never trusting terminal output for artifact identity/content (TestCodexResealUsesReceiverNotProviderStdout)? BC3 — is `CapabilityReseal` declared a daemon-INTERNAL capability marker projected by a private `resealInFlightJob` mutation (not a public bearer-auth capability the prelude at `server.go:107-111` / `auth_pg.go:159-206` would need a bearer token to reach), with the public route-alternate kept for tests only, and the reseal payload schema + validation/reuse path for publish/complete/answer defined? ALSO verify F2 and F4 are not regressed. Then hunt for any NEW material gap in the security/authz core.

jobs.title: Falsifier 2 (lifecycle: generation + grace + lock-order lens)

jobs.objective: Read only the dialogue trajectory for the RFC 0143 v3 REVISION (the revised HOLDER.md and the two FALSIFIER.md re-attacks), with the design-v2 HOLDER.md and the v2 collaboration ledger as context for what the revision had to fix. Publish the collaboration ledger verdict (one of accept, accept_with_findings, needs_revision, reject — a clearing verdict is accept or accept_with_findings, never `clear`). A clearing verdict REQUIRES that ALL FIVE binding constraints BC1-BC5 are genuinely resolved (BC1 a real private non-PTY-output control channel or a reserved exit code recorded without parsing output; BC2 artifact identity derived from daemon `expected_artifacts` state, not terminal output; BC3 `CapabilityReseal` declared a daemon-internal marker projected by `resealInFlightJob` with a defined reseal payload schema + validation path; BC4 a concrete monotonic recovery/lease generation column with migration site, increment points, and stamped value; BC5 a numeric `resealGrace` with source + maximum, an exact lock order vs publish/complete/recovery-sweep, and expired-beyond-grace always routing the typed class) AND the v2-credited resolved set (F2, F4, F7 file-mirror half, AF1, AF4, no-admin-token-widening, the falsifiable-assertion discipline) carried forward UNREGRESSED AND no new material challenge stands unrebutted. needs_revision if any BC remains open, if any credited item is regressed, or any new material challenge lands; reject only if a path widens admin-token exposure or mints a credential carrying any of {admin,apply,recovery,surgical_recovery}. Note that Slice B (the new CapabilityReseal class + supervisor-mediated reseal path + endpoint/epoch republish) still requires maintainer ratification before any build slice touches credential code; adjudicator clearance gates the spec's soundness, not the maintainer's product call.
